text:
Maya: Quick q — our eviction telemetry bill spiked last week. wondering if we can sample prefix eviction events to cut cost without blinding alerts.

Kevin: Short answer: yes, but need deterministic sampling per prefix or tenant so we can still reason about hotkeys and aggregation. random sampling will make anomaly thresholds noisy.

Srini: Agree on deterministic. One approach: hash(prefix_id) % 100 < SAMPLE_PCT. That keeps distribution stable across hosts. e.g.
```
SAMPLE_PCT = 10
if hash(prefix_id) % 100 < SAMPLE_PCT:
    emit_metric("evict.event", {"prefix": prefix_id, "sample_rate": SAMPLE_PCT})
```

Jess: Also add a fallback: heavy-hitter detector (count sketch) on ingest that flags top N prefixes to always emit full telemetry. That way we don't miss hotkey regressions.

Ava: From ops POV, we care about detection latency for eviction storms. Sampling will increase time-to-detect unless we bias sampling to tenants with high previous variance. Can we make sample rate adaptive?

Kevin: Adaptive sampling is doable: keep a small sliding window per tenant that tracks eviction variance; bump SAMPLE_PCT for tenants where variance or recent error rate > threshold. Still use deterministic hash to keep consistency.

Maya: Important: emitted metrics must include the sample_rate tag so alerts and dashboards can scale counts back up. Otherwise team will misinterpret absolute numbers.

Srini: Implementation note — avoid increasing cardinality by tagging too many dimensions. Use a stable enum for sample bands (e.g., s0=100%, s1=10%, s2=1%) not raw percentages.

Jess: Rollout plan proposal:
- Phase 1: 10% deterministic sampling globally + annotate sample band. parity logging enabled for full-events for 24h (no rollbacks).
- Phase 2: enable heavy-hitter detector to exempt top-1k prefixes. compare match rate.
- Phase 3: adaptive sampling by tenant.

Ava: For alerts, we should run an A/B on existing rules for 48h to ensure alert sensitivity isn't degraded. Ops runbook needs a line: "if > X% of evict events are sampled, escalate to SRE lead".

Maya: Can someone put up a small PR with the sample code + metric tag and a config flag runaway:evict_telemetry_sampling? I can do the rollout change window.

Kevin: I'll prototype the hash-based sampler and metric tag. Will throw up a draft in #eng-runtime-ops later today.

evict-bot: [alert] eviction-rate-surge tenant-308 (rate=120r/s) — suppressed in sampled stream (seen via parity logs).

Maya: Perfect. If parity logs show <1% divergence after phase1, we can increase to 25% to save more cost. :thumbsup:

Jess: One more: add a regression check in our evals — replay historical full telemetry with sampler to estimate false-negative risk before each phase.

Maya: Agreed. Thanks all — logging action items:
- Kevin: draft sampler + PR
- Jess: heavy-hitter sketch plan + eval replay
- Ava: update alert A/B plan & runbook
- Srini: telemetry band enum and metric tagging format

Maya: Will follow up with rollout window once PR is up.
